about.title: About me
about.text: As a certified Full Stack Developer (RNCP Title Level 6 – INSTA Paris), I like to think of a project as a system: from data architecture to user experience, including business logic. I design web applications from start to finish, with the aim of structuring and industrializing my developments—tests, CI/CD, best practices. Curious and rigorous, I spend a good part of my free time exploring new tools and deepening my personal projects, always with the idea to put this requirement at the service of a team and concrete projects.

cloud-quizz.title: Cloud Quizz
cloud-quizz.description: E-commerce platform combining interactive quizzes, community forums and online store. Each quiz has its own exchange area, and users can enrich their experience by purchasing additional quizzes or games via the integrated store. The project includes a role system (user, premium, moderator, administrator), secure payment via Stripe, and an automatically switchable maintenance mode.

tech-city-front.title: Tech City — Front-End
tech-city-front.description: Frontend e-commerce application dedicated to the sale of computer components and peripherals. It allows you to browse a product catalog, manage a cart synchronized with the backend, save favorites, view order history and download invoices, and pay online securely via Stripe. A dedicated administration interface allows the management of products, orders and users.

tech-city-back.title: Tech City — Back-End
tech-city-back.description: REST API that powers the Tech City e-commerce platform. It manages authentication by JWT with refresh token, product catalog, cart and favorites, orders with PDF invoice generation, secure payment via Stripe, and the sending of transactional emails. Several security mechanisms are implemented: password hashing, protection against brute-force attacks, request rate limit and secure HTTP headers.

portfolio-dev.title: Developer Portfolio
portfolio-dev.description: Personal portfolio developed in React and TypeScript, designed to present my background, skills and projects. Fully trilingual (French, English, Portuguese), with light and dark themes, neat animations and a visual identity inspired by development terminals. It was my first project done in TypeScript.

api-meteo.title: Weather API
api-meteo.description: Weather app consuming the WeatherAPI.com API to display current weather, 3-day forecasts, air quality (US EPA index) and weather alerts for a location. The search is done by city name, postal code or GPS coordinates. All the network call logic is isolated in a custom hook, to clearly separate data retrieval from its display.

redux-bookshelf.title: Redux Bookshelf
redux-bookshelf.description: Personal library manager allowing you to add your books manually or to search for them via the Google Books API, then to save them in your library, which is persisted in the browser. The project puts into practice "classic" Redux (without Redux Toolkit): store, pure reducers, action creators and asynchronous management with Redux Thunk middleware, in an architecture separating presentation components and containers connected to the store.
